storyInfo: The truth is revealed at the end of the hearing: The Ursus Student Self-government Group reunites and rescues the other imprisoned students. Antosha mourns his fallen friends and joins a group of workers. The First Army's new weapon is ready for testing. Ursus is once again shrouded in dark clouds.

attributes.content: Order.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The witnesses have spoken. All present have heard their statements.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Considering the scope of the Katorga Incident, and the many contradictions in the testimonies we have heard...
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The committee will now adjourn to deliberate behind closed doors.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: This hearing is hereby concluded. We will announce the final verdict on the Katorga Incident in two hours.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: (Whispers) It's time.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Discussions surround her again. A few nobles accompany the arbiter out of the chamber and into the inner council building.
Absinthe shakes her head and walks through the noisy crowd, meeting the parliamentarian's eyes as she leaves.
The parliamentarian is impassive, his gaze penetrating her and casting into nothingness beyond. But he silently raises his notebook—
It is completely empty.
Phew... what a farce.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Even the scion of Treplev strays. It is beyond belief.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The focus is still on Sonya Mykhailivna. How do you intend to portray her, Arbiter?
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: It depends on what kind of 'cautionary tale' we need her to be.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: We need her to be a lunatic.
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: The new nobles are trying to use His Imperial Majesty as a shield. They even have the audacity to praise her for protecting the emperor!
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: We must magnify Sonya Mykhailivna's threat. This is our opportunity to deal with the upstarts now. Fail to do so, and they will grow even bolder and continue to distort the truth!
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: We will decide when Duke Treplev arrives. He needs time to recover from the shock.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Wait...
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: What's that sound?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Arbiter!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: What happened?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Word just came in that Prison No. 3 was raided! Many prisoners have escaped.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: It's a mess out there right now. Your presence is needed to maintain order.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: How did they get into Prison No. 3 so easily?!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Most of our units were deployed to this area. Those left were unable to spot the miscreants in time.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: ...Wait.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The students outside?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: They just dispersed. Do you mean...?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: I mean find their leader and bring him in right this instant, you fool!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Yes, sir!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Hey, wake up!
attributes.name: Motivated Student

attributes.content: Who are you?
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: You must be Rania. We've seized this prison.
attributes.name: Motivated Student

attributes.content: We should leave before reinforcements arrive.
attributes.name: Motivated Student

attributes.content: Is this real... you came to rescue me?
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: Not just you. Come.
attributes.name: Motivated Student

attributes.content: Feeling a mixture of joy and surprise through his sleepy mind, Rania steps over a jailer lying on the ground.
His thoughts drift. So his reputation has grown so great... he will return to the Student Assembly, and become a leader on par with Olga.
Students... friends, comrades!
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: I knew that the flames of liberty never died as soon as I saw you!
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: Group Two, hold the gap! The cells on this side are all open!
attributes.name: Motivated Student

attributes.content: *cough*—
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: As you can see, though the dank cage trapped my flesh, it could never hold my—
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: Out of the way!
attributes.name: Busy Student

attributes.content: ...It's alright.
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: I know you came for me. For—
attributes.name: Rania

attributes.content: No one answers. His former fellows seem so unfamiliar to him now.
Phew, I'm exhausted.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I'd hardly gotten the dust of that hellhole off before you dragged me into this.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Oh, quit complaining, not even Zoya's saying anything.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Are your plans always this bold, Sonya?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I didn't think we could pull this off right under their noses...
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: We were worried when you said you would appear at the hearing to stall for time.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Natalya had already made the arrangements. You didn't need to take the risk.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Gummy didn't have to be here, but she came.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Hmph, speaking of which...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I already apologized! Besides, I hardly got hurt at all, and Istina said I helped! Don't scold me.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Who said I was scolding you?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If not for you and Instructor Dur-nar... and Crownslayer, we would have had to be on guard against attacks from the mobility layer. You definitely helped.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Hey, she admits it. Just as today's operation may not have gone so smoothly if Zoya hadn't gone to the hearing and played her role.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: We won't exclude anyone anymore.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I wasn't excluding them... never mind. We all saw that my plan was bad.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But I didn't expect to see all the students with all their different ideas and methods come together into a single coherent team by the time I saw you all again.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Good work, Istina.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Who was the reckless fool who gave me no choice but to do that?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Alright, both of you, it's time for us to think about what's next.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Oh yeah, before we left, Instructor Dur-nar told us not to go back to the office when we're done, and go straight to a safehouse that Rhodes Island prepared.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: How did she put it... 'lay low until it blows over'?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: We'll have to operate covertly in Grypherburg moving forward. Fortunately, I've already made arrangements with the school, and we'll have no problem receiving intel from them.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Let's get moving, then.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Mm-hm.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Let's go!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: One moment.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Aren't you forgetting something, Zoya?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Seeing Zima's inquiring gaze, she realizes what Zima was talking about and takes out a brand-new iron badge from her bag. A tightly clenched fist is depicted upon the badge.
Good, you have it. Don't you forget it.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You should have been one of us. You are now, and you always will be.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima...
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: My condolences, Zoya.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Zima may be all smiles and sunshine most of the time, and she never used to like wearing this herself. But now, wait till you see the look on her face if she ever catches you without that badge—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: That's enough of that. We have some laying low to get to.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: So many twists and turns. This place sure is hard to find.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Probably to ensure security.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Yeah. Zoya and I were moving from safehouse to safehouse, just like this, from one week to the next while you were operating in the other cities, so that we could continue to receive intel and plan our next steps.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Not a job for me, at any rate. I would be bored to death in two days under normal circumstances.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: It's not that bad.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Just Rosalind being her restless self.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Oh—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: There you are.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Huh, this is your safehouse?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Just consider it as Rhodes Island's.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Sonya, is that...?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: 'Crownslayer' Lyudmila. Operator for the Grypherburg office, just like us.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: (Nods)
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: They don't recognize you. Looks like you didn't really take what I said to heart.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Rhodes resources in Ursus are limited. They should be reserved for those who need them the most.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Besides, I did go to the office and got Gummy's help.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: We helped each other!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Well, that's a start, at least.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You can stay here for a while. Dur-nar will let you know once things blow over.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hm? What about you?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I'm leaving Grypherburg for a bit.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: There has been a major development with the mark I was tracking. I have to go and verify.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Gummy...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Mm-hm.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Why are you following me? Go back.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You're going to the place Papa talked about in the message, aren't you?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: It's my mission.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: But...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: It's my Papa.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I don't even know which satellite city he was talking about specifically. Following me doesn't mean you'll find your father.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It's not about the danger. But it's just not necessary right now for you to—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Lyudmila.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Yes?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Will you tell me if you find that satellite city and see my parents?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I will.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Okay. I have one more question.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Rosa said you used to be with Reunion.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: That's true.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: But Zima said it wasn't important, and Leto said she didn't plan on having much to do with you anyway.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Istina and Absinthe were quiet. I have my own ideas.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: You weren't there, were you?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: You weren't at Peterheim.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: The red-haired woman falls silent. She clutches her fists in the darkness before relaxing them.
She looks into the girl's earnest eyes, then slowly shakes her head.
But I was in Chernobog.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I was part of Reunion. I share responsibility for its evils, whether they passed through my hands or not.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Running away won't do any good. I don't ask for forgiveness or reconciliation. But this time, just this once...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: If there's still a chance to make things right again, I have to go and take it.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Gummy's eyes widen as she ponders Crownslayer's words. Then she smiles and takes out a honey drop from her pocket.
Through the gloves, she puts it into Crownslayer's palm.
What's this—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: A promise.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I know why Zima said it wasn't important. We've grown up, we're old enough that we can find calm in our hearts without having to take it out on someone, without having to hate.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I'll wait for you to come back, with news about Papa or Mama—or both!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I want to believe. I want to believe in you, Lyudmila.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: The following day, I went back to that street, alone.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Hey, careful, this job's from the Council faction, if we break anything—
attributes.name: Cautious Worker

attributes.content: Did you see it, though? That idiot Pavlovich was crushed to a pulp in that quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Excited Worker

attributes.content: Maybe we all trampled his corpse!
attributes.name: Excited Worker

attributes.content: Keep quiet! Not everyone here's on our side.
attributes.name: Cautious Worker

attributes.content: Come on, who else could there be, we're all—
attributes.name: Excited Worker

attributes.content: W-Who are you?
attributes.name: Excited Worker

attributes.content: I'm looking for someone. I won't bother you. If you're worried that I might snitch—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Pavlovich deserved it.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Antosha bows and walks through the workers to the other side of the street, that door in his memories.
After he was expelled and left penniless, it was Matvey who took him home, where he really felt like he was eating with family for the first time since he came to Grypherburg.
He remembers Matvey's mother, always with a serene smile on her face as she stirred the pot of borscht and quietly ladled one of the few pieces of meat into his bowl.
He looks up, greeted by the familiar scent of beets and onions.
Dim light seeps out of the slightly open curtain. He could not help but peek.
An old woman takes out a clay pot from the cramped kitchen, and pours borscht into three separate bowls.
Three?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Could that be for me—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What did you write in your letter...?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Hello? Somebody there?
Hearing a voice coming from inside the house, he tucks the notice of Matvey's death into the edge of the window and flees like a thief in the night.
(Whispers) Govno!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: (Whispers) When did you become such a coward, Antosha?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What's the rush, young man? Could you move over a little?
attributes.name: Resting Worker

attributes.content: The burdenbeast's tired. Moving old furniture's not an easy task, eh?
attributes.name: Resting Worker

attributes.content: Antosha nods and shifts sideways.
Matvey?!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: The mirror on the burdenbeast cart reflects the grey street, his own unkempt visage, and a silhouette from what is now the past.
Matvey's face is covered in sunlight. He seems so real, so alive, no lamentation on his face, nor dust-covered wound, only a cherry flower on his chest...
The color of blood, diffuses from the center of the flower out towards the petals.
Is that you, friend?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I saw you, List, Yura... I...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I remember everyone's death, your prayers and farewells, and those who never left their last words.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Will you tell me that none of this was real? You will, won't you?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: No, Antosha.
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: Did you ever imagine the life I could have led?
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: I would have stayed in school, made more friends, and writtn the first poem of the year by the river in the spring.
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: When there is no class in the afternoon, I would have gone home, reading the words I wrote for my mother while she made soup.
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: She would not understand, but she would smile and say, 'Tuck in, my university synochek.'
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: Ah...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Matvey, Matvey...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Why am I the one who lived...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Because you still have a chance to live the life I wanted.
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: Let it go, Antosha. You have carried that burden for so many years.
attributes.name: 'Matvey'

attributes.content: A beautiful life like that... can I truly live it?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: ...Can every Ursine?
attributes.name: Antosha
Antosha
attributes.content: If I had never chosen to resist this land of oppression, Matvey...

attributes.name: Antosha
attributes.content: Would you and I have become friends?
The figure from the past does not answer, but only sighs softly.
It is the second time that Antosha has wept since he left home.
He still lives, but part of his soul will remain beneath the rubble of Katorga forever.
Live...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: If I give up now, Matvey will forever remain a traitor to the empire's nobility.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: One day, I will carve his name and the professor's, and the names of all the Unbound, on a plaque for the martyrs...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Give me time, my friend.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: He wipes his eyes with his dirty, dusty sleeves.
Then, he moves his feet and joins the workers' procession.
On the other end of the procession, a young man gazes upon this unfamiliar city, not even realizing that the crate on his shoulder has slipped off.
Hey, brother!
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: What's so interesting? Let us see it too.
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: I think... no, never mind.
attributes.name: Nikto

attributes.content: You've been with us for a few days already, no need to be shy! Look more cheerful, we're in Grypherburg!
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: Grypherburg...
attributes.name: Nikto

attributes.content: Yes, it was a hard journey to Grypherburg...
attributes.name: Nikto

attributes.content: The light in the sky begins to fade, like a curtain being closed.
What's the Marshal summoning us for?
attributes.name: Nervous Officer

attributes.content: Is it not enough that he beheaded his bodyguards for the assassination attempt? Does he want our heads too?
attributes.name: Nervous Officer

attributes.content: Or you're overthinking it. There's just some situation developing.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: Even after that small rebellion two weeks ago, the Fourth Army is still in a stalemate with the Second Army on the whole.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: What do you mean?
attributes.name: Nervous Officer

attributes.content: It's just a guess, but we may not be able to stay out of this for much longer.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: But the First Army has always been—
attributes.name: Nervous Officer

attributes.content: Always been?
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: ...A-Always been independent of any faction. We do not participate in political struggles, and we only ever fight for Ursus's interests.
attributes.name: Nervous Officer

attributes.content: Correct.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: And in that case, you have nothing to fear.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: If I may be frank, Marshal, you must have an important reason for summoning us back from our respective assignments.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: Of course.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: What is the reason?
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: Our new weapon has passed theoretical validation. It is now ready for testing.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: We must coordinate and conclude this test discreetly.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier
